trophies.name: Super Mario Master
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.

trophies.name: First Steps
trophies.description: Complete World 1.

trophies.name: Two Much Trouble
trophies.description: Complete World 2.

trophies.name: Third Time's the Charm
trophies.description: Complete World 3.

trophies.name: Four the Win
trophies.description: Complete World 4.

trophies.name: High Five
trophies.description: Complete World 5.

trophies.name: Six Feet Under
trophies.description: Complete World 6.

trophies.name: Lucky Seven
trophies.description: Complete World 7.

trophies.name: The Final World
trophies.description: Complete World 8.

trophies.name: Course Correction
trophies.description: Complete all 32 courses in the game.

trophies.name: Here We Go!
trophies.description: Defeat Bowser in World 1-4.

trophies.name: Castle Crusher
trophies.description: Complete all eight Castle courses.

trophies.name: Not So Fast, Bowser
trophies.description: Defeat the real Bowser in World 8-4 and rescue Princess Toadstool.

trophies.name: Coin-Opener
trophies.description: Enter a hidden Coin Room.

trophies.name: Head in the Clouds
trophies.description: Enter a hidden Coin Heaven bonus area.

trophies.name: Warp Speed
trophies.description: Use the Warp Zone in World 1-2 to travel to another world.

trophies.name: Take the Shortcut
trophies.description: Use a Warp Zone in World 4-2 to travel to another world.

trophies.name: Warp and Tear
trophies.description: Use every legitimate Warp Zone destination available in the game.

trophies.name: Extra Life of the Party
trophies.description: Collect all ten 1-Up Mushrooms hidden throughout the game.

trophies.name: Pipe Dream
trophies.description: Discover every hidden Coin Room, Coin Heaven, and other bonus area accessible through secret pipes.

trophies.name: Fireworks Finale
trophies.description: Finish a course with 1, 3, or 6 remaining in the timer to trigger the fireworks.

trophies.name: Pole Position
trophies.description: Reach the very top of a flagpole and earn the maximum flagpole bonus.

trophies.name: Coin-Collector
trophies.description: Collect 100 coins without losing a life.

trophies.name: Super Star
trophies.description: Defeat enemies while under the effect of a Super Star.

trophies.name: Hot Stuff
trophies.description: Defeat an enemy using a Fire Flower.

trophies.name: Shell Shocked
trophies.description: Defeat a Koopa Troopa by kicking its shell.

trophies.name: Hammer Time
trophies.description: Defeat a Hammer Bro.

trophies.name: Up to No Good
trophies.description: Collect a hidden 1-Up Mushroom from an invisible block.

trophies.name: Shortcut to Completion
trophies.description: Use a Warp Zone and still complete the game.

trophies.name: The Long Way Around
trophies.description: Complete the game without using a Warp Zone.

trophies.name: Hard Mode, Harder
trophies.description: Unlock the second quest by completing the game.

trophies.name: A New Quest
trophies.description: Complete the second quest.
